statement: ∀ (s ε : ℝ) (W : ℕ → Set (V (n+1))) (i : ℕ), 0 < s → 0 < ε → Metric.ediam (W i) = ENNReal.ofReal (Metric.diam (W i)) → 0 ≤ Metric.diam (W i) → (Metric.ediam (W i)) ^ s * ENNReal.ofReal (Metric.diam (W i) + padding ε s W i) ≤ (Metric.ediam (W i)) ^ (s+1) + ENNReal.ofReal ε * ENNReal.ofReal ((2 : ℝ) ^ (-(i : ℝ)-1))
proof:
intro s ε W i hs hε he hd
have ha : 0 ≤ (Metric.diam (W i)) ^ s := Real.rpow_nonneg hd s
have hg : 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(i : ℝ)-1) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by norm_num) _
have hb : 0 ≤ ε * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(i : ℝ)-1) := mul_nonneg hε.le hg
have hpad : padding ε s W i * (Metric.diam (W i)) ^ s ≤ ε * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(i : ℝ)-1) := by
  unfold padding
  apply (div_mul_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 1 + (Metric.diam (W i)) ^ s)).2
  nlinarith
have halg : (Metric.diam (W i)) ^ s * (Metric.diam (W i) + padding ε s W i) ≤ (Metric.diam (W i)) ^ (s+1) + ε * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(i : ℝ)-1) := by
  rw [Real.rpow_add_of_nonneg hd hs.le (by norm_num), Real.rpow_one]
  nlinarith
rw [he, ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg hd hs.le, ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg hd (by linarith)]
rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul ha]
exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal halg).trans (ENNReal.ofReal_add_le.trans (add_le_add_left (le_of_eq (ENNReal.ofReal_mul hε.le)) _))
